newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: SOCCER-COLOMBIA END BLEAK RUN WITH LAST-GASP GOAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COLOMBIA END BLEAK RUN WITH LAST-GASP GOAL.

text.p: Colombia, who had taken just one point from their last five World Cup qualifiers, scored a dramatic last-gasp goal to beat Ecuador 1-0 on Sunday.
Substitute Antony de Avila's 86th minute effort ended several months of suffering for Colombia but was a bitter pill for Ecuador, whose chances of a first World Cup appearance took a severe knock.

Colombia stayed third in the South American World Cup qualifying group with 21 points from 13 games, while Ecuador dropped to seventh with 15 from 13 games. The top four teams go to the World Cup in France next year.
Colombia coach Hernan Dario Gomez had said beforehand that he would resign if Colombia failed to win and at times it looked as Colombia would have a new coach.
Jose Gavica missed an excellent chance for Ecuador, who are coached by former Colombia boss Franciso Maturana, in the 20th minute.

In the 26th minute, Colombia goalkeeper Oscar Cordoba made a superb save to defy Eduardo Hurtado and shortly afterwards, Ecuador had a penalty appeal turned down when Alex Aguinaga appeared to be fouled.
At the other end, Colombia's Freddy Rincon blasted an effort against the post.
Cordoba had been recalled after a series of blunders by Farid Mondragon and fully justified his inclusion with another save in the second half to foil Ecuador's Argentine-born striker Ariel Graziani.
With a draw apparently on the cards, Faustino Asprilla, who has hit a goalscoring drought with Colombia, missed an excellent chance in the 79th minute.

But seven minutes later, de Avila, who replaced Victor Aristizabal on the hour, received the ball with his back to goal, turned and scored with a left foot shot to break the deadlock and earn his team three priceless points.

Colombia - Oscar Cordoba, Wilmer Cabrera, Ivan Cordoba, Jorge Bermudez, Antonio Moreno, John Wilmer Perez, Harold Lozano, Freddy Rincon (Victor Danilo Pacheco, 63), Carlos Valderrama, Faustino Asprilla (Andres Estrada, 90), Victor Aristizabal (Antony de Avila, 59).

Ecuador - Jose Francisco Cevallos, Walter Rivera, Ivan Hurtado (Ariel Graziani, 57), Alberto Montano, Luis Capurro, Jimmy Blandon, Hector Carabali, Wellington Sanchez, Jose Gavica, Alex Aguinaga, Eduardo Hurtado.
